create_sandbox_mturk_agent: create a SandboxMTurkAgent instance for a worker to work on a given Unit in the sandbox
get_sandbox_client: get an MTurk sandbox client for this agent using the requester name from the datastore
approve_sandbox_work: approve the work done by a sandbox MTurk agent on a specific Unit with an optional bonus
reject_sandbox_work: reject the work done by a sandbox MTurk agent on a specific Unit with a review note
reconcile_sandbox_submitted_data: reconcile submitted data from the MTurk sandbox by fetching assignment answers directly from the HIT
